## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector leadership (Healthcare, Staples, Utilities leading while Technology, Materials and pockets of Financials lag) and narrow top-performer concentration (Leadership: Narrow — 3/5 Healthcare in Top 5); MAJOR divergence across megacaps advises caution.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Healthcare leads: MRK (1W: +12.04% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples and Utilities also showing upside: KHC (1W: +9.80% | 1M: +0.65%) ABOVE TREND and Utilities 1W: +1.91% (10 stocks).

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Materials, Financials and Technology are the weakest pockets: DOW (1W: -9.32% | 1M: -18.88%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -10.97% | 1M: -6.45%) BELOW TREND; GS (1W: -7.79% | 1M: +1.62%) TREND EXHAUSTION, BLK (1W: -9.66% | 1M: -8.69%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -9.85%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +16.43% | 1M: -0.74%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, PANW (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.04% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Healthcare) — strength concentrated.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: GS (1W: -7.79% | 1M: +1.62%) TREND EXHAUSTION, TJX (1W: -7.88% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -9.32% | 1M: -18.88%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -9.66% | 1M: -8.69%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -20.80%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Materials/Select Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Big 1W movers: CHTR (1W: +16.43% | 1M: -0.74%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL, PANW (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.04% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND; watch MA (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through. MAJOR divergence flagged among megacaps (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, TSLA, JPM showing 1W vs 1M mismatches) — tactical, not broad, until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed and under pressure overall: PANW (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%) ABOVE TREND and IBM (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +5.22%) ABOVE TREND are exceptions while AAPL (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -9.85%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -15.60% | 1M: -27.46%) BELOW TREND are weak; Tech 1W: -0.62% | 1M: -3.13% (24 stocks).

8. Financials Outlook?  
Mixed rotation: V (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND versus GS (1W: -7.79% | 1M: +1.62%) TREND EXHAUSTION and BLK (1W: -9.66% | 1M: -8.69%) BELOW TREND; Financials 1W: -0.64% | 1M: +4.79% (20 stocks).

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Clear sector leadership and breadth: JNJ (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.04% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare 1W: +6.04% | 1M: +5.79% (17 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor exposure to Healthcare and selective Staples/Utilities (JNJ, MRK, LLY, KHC) given leadership and breadth, and reduce exposure to Technology names that remain BELOW TREND (AAPL, NVDA, ORCL). Monitor big-cap divergence (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, JPM) and wait for confirmation before rotating more broadly.

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.04% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -15.60% | 1M: -27.46%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -14.95% | 1M: -22.14%) BELOW TREND, TXN (1W: -14.08% | 1M: -9.64%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +6.04% | 1M: +5.79%) and Consumer Staples (1W: +2.61% | 1M: +0.58%) — monitor earnings/news flow. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -3.08% | 1M: -2.22%) and Technology (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -3.13%) — watch for further dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch big-cap trend checks: AAPL (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -9.85%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming 1M downtrend would be a constructive trigger; NVDA (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -8.89%) BELOW TREND — hold/violate of this week’s lows will dictate momentum. Monitor JPM (1W: -0.63% | 1M: +11.01%) TREND EXHAUSTION for confirmation of Financials rotation and PANW (1W: +15.92% | 1M: +28.80%) ABOVE TREND for tech rebound signals.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
GS (+50): GS (1W: -7.79% | 1M: +1.62%) TREND EXHAUSTION — bullish headlines but 1W weakness is a divergence to watch. ORCL (+50): ORCL (1W: -15.60% | 1M: -27.46%) BELOW TREND — positive partner headlines vs falling price, divergence. BA (+50): BA (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -6.16%) BELOW TREND — deal news supportive but price remains below trend.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
MRK (-50): MRK (1W: +12.04% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price is confirming strength (divergence between news and price). FCX (-50): FCX (1W: -10.97% | 1M: -6.45%) BELOW TREND — bearish news confirmed by sharp downside. CME (-45): CME (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -20.80%) BELOW TREND — negative notes aligning with price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership.  
Healthcare leaders JNJ (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +12.01%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.04% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.15%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: MAJOR divergence across megacaps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, AMZN) and mixed sentiment vs price (e.g., MRK news negative but price strong; ORCL headlines positive but price BELOW TREND) — monitor for confirmation before broader rotation.
